_comment: Toggle surface for the 'How I operate' highlights strip. Flip enabled:true/false and re-run `python3 scripts/build-highlights.py`. Disabled insights are NOT computed or emitted — they never reach the public page. Array order = display order. label/caption/accent are optional per-insight overrides. `primary: true` insights are shown up front; the rest sit under 'All the numbers'.

section.label: By the numbers
section.title: How I operate.
section.sub: A snapshot from across my repos (public + private), generated from real git history — the operating habits behind the work above. Commit-history metrics cover 2026 to date.

_since_note: Bounds commit-history metrics (commits, cadence, Conventional %, PR count, AI-assisted %) to this date. Point-in-time counts (files, docs, notes, evals, tools) are current snapshots, not windowed. All configured repos started in 2026, so today this is a no-op safeguard; it keeps the window honest if an older repo is ever added.

latest_ship._note: Opt-in only. Sources are 'repo_path::doc' for changelogs that are ALREADY publicly published. Emits one plain-English headline + date, never a repo name.

insights._note: GitHub contribution-calendar total (commits+PRs+issues+reviews, public+private) via `gh api graphql`, bounded by `since`. The one metric that can't come from local git — GitHub aggregates it server-side. Needs the gh CLI authenticated locally; if gh is missing/errors the tile is silently skipped.
